verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first search engine, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, the probe found no spec at any candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json all returned 404), and no doc in the pack mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent schema. The llms.txt file, the markdown docs, the MCP server and the typed SDKs are AI-friendly assets, but none is a machine-readable API spec. Confidence is medium because the probe only checked guessed paths on the marketing domain.
